card.title: 20. PANZERGRENADIER
card.text: Deployment: Add a PANZER 35(t) and a COMBINED ARMS to your hand.
card.flavorText: The 20th Panzergrenadier Regiment was a unit of the 10th Panzergrenadier Division, formally known as the 10th Infantry Division, of the German Wehrmacht. Prior to being redesignated as a panzer division in 1943, the division participated in the invasion of Poland in 1939 and the Invasion of France in 1940. In 1943 the Panzergrenadier Division was sent to the southern regions of the Eastern Front where it fought in a series of defensive battles against the advancing Red Army. In August 1944 the division was destroyed during the second Jassy–Kishinev offensive, a Soviet offensive against Axis forces which took place in Eastern Romania. In 1945 the division was formed again, but it was destroyed a second time shortly after in Poland. From February 2, 1945, the 10th Panzergrenadier Division was re-established as a combat group near Görlitz, and in March 1945 it fought north of the Neisse in Oberschlesien, before surrendering to the Red Army when the war ended.
